immediate.judge: I will decide immediately on the issues as organized. We will move to the judgment phase.

conditional.judge: I will first present a conditional mediation that separates the core responsibilities. The intent behind the nine days of contact, the nuance of the fiancé's messages, the old fallout, and the father-related texts will not be treated as one bundle.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: Ms. Song's side can hear a conditional mediation. But the intent behind the nine days of contact has to be put on paper first, or the same misunderstanding just keeps coming back.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: Ms. Choi's side can hear the conditional terms as well. But the circumstances of the past breakup and the texts about her father — and why I went around her — must be addressed together.

postpone.judge: I will first fix only the facts that can be established and reserve the rest. For the old fallout and the father-related issues, I will separate the records from the parties' explanations.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: Ms. Song's side can accept reserving a decision. But the intent behind the nine days of contact at least has to be drawn out today, or further confusion will only grow.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: Ms. Choi's side also believes the circumstances need a closer look before any hasty conclusion. But please make it clear that reserving a decision is not the same as being cleared.

fact_first.judge: Before discussing a remedy, I will first settle the facts. We will fix where the nine days of contact, the fiancé's messages, and the circumstances of the old fallout connect to one another.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: Ms. Song's side agrees with sorting facts out first. At minimum, the intent behind the nine days of contact has to be fixed against the records first.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: Ms. Choi's side can accept facts before solutions. But the reason I made contact and how Da-eun received it have to be looked at separately.
